content.short: Toku runs global payroll and employer-of-record services, paying teams in fiat or stablecoins.
content.description: Toku handles global payroll and acts as an employer of record, so companies can hire and pay teams anywhere compliantly, including in stablecoins with money that moves in minutes. It is widely used by crypto companies for token compensation. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Toku.
content.meta: Toku provides global payroll and EOR with stablecoin payouts, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
